title.zh: 卷八十 志第三十: 輿服三
title.raw: 卷八十 志第三十: 輿服三 Volume 80 Treatises 33: Carriages and Clothes 3

sentences.zh: 輿服三 ○儀衛殿上執事

translations.literal: Carriages and Clothes 3. Ceremonial guard: attendants on the upper hall.
translations.idiomatic: Carriages and Clothes, Part 3 — Ceremonial Guard: Upper-Hall Attendants

sentences.zh: 挈壺郎二人，掌直漏刻，冠學士帽，服紫羅窄袖衫，塗金束帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Two Qiehu Lang, in charge of maintaining the clepsydra, wore scholar's caps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, gilded belts, and black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Two water-clock officers maintained the clepsydra; they wore scholar's caps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, gilded belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 漏刻直禦榻南。

translations.literal: The clepsydra stood directly south of the imperial couch.
translations.idiomatic: The water clock stood directly south of the imperial couch.

sentences.zh: 司香二人，掌侍香，以主服御者

translations.literal: Two incense officers, in charge of attending the incense, were drawn from those who attend imperial garments
translations.idiomatic: Two incense officers tended the incense, drawn from the imperial wardrobe attendants

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰速古兒赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called sugu'erchi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called sugu'erchi.)

sentences.zh: 攝之，冠服同挈壺。

translations.literal: who filled these posts; caps and dress were the same as the water-clock officers.
translations.idiomatic: who filled these posts; their caps and dress matched the water-clock officers.

sentences.zh: 香案二，在漏刻東西稍南。

translations.literal: Two incense tables, slightly south of the clepsydra to east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Two incense tables stood slightly south of the water clock, one to the east and one to the west.

sentences.zh: 司香侍案側，東西相向立。

translations.literal: The incense officers attended beside the tables, standing facing each other east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The incense officers stood beside the tables, facing each other across the east–west axis.

sentences.zh: 酒人，凡六十人，主酒

translations.literal: Wine stewards, sixty in all, in charge of wine
translations.idiomatic: Wine stewards, sixty in all, supervised the wine

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰答剌赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called darachi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called darachi.)

sentences.zh: 二十人，主湩

translations.literal: twenty persons, in charge of fermented mare's milk
translations.idiomatic: twenty attended to fermented mare's milk

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰郃剌赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called ho'erchi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called ho'erchi.)

sentences.zh: 二十人，主膳

translations.literal: twenty persons, in charge of meals
translations.idiomatic: twenty managed the meals

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰博兒赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called bo'erchi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called bo'erchi.)

sentences.zh: 二十人。

translations.literal: twenty persons.
translations.idiomatic: twenty in number.

sentences.zh: 冠唐帽，服同司香。

translations.literal: They wore Tang caps; dress was the same as the incense officers.
translations.idiomatic: They wore Tang-style caps and the same dress as the incense officers.

sentences.zh: 酒海直漏南，酒人北面立酒海南。

translations.literal: The wine sea stood directly south of the clepsydra; the wine stewards stood facing north south of the wine sea.
translations.idiomatic: The great wine vessel stood directly south of the water clock; the wine stewards faced north and stood south of it.

sentences.zh: 護尉四十人，以質子在宿衛者攝之。

translations.literal: Forty guard-commanders, drawn from hostages serving in the night guard.
translations.idiomatic: Forty guard-commanders were drawn from hostages on palace night duty.

sentences.zh: 〈（質子，國語曰睹魯花。）〉

translations.literal: (Hostages; in the national language they are called turulghu.)
translations.idiomatic: (Hostages; in the national language they are called turulghu.)

sentences.zh: 冠交角襆頭，紫梅花羅窄袖衫，塗金束帶，白錦汗胯，帶弓矢，佩刀，執骨朵，分立東西宇下。

translations.literal: They wore crossed-corner headwraps, purple plum-blossom gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, gilded belts, white brocade riding breeches, carried bow and arrows, wore swords, held clubs, and stood divided east and west beneath the eaves.
translations.idiomatic: They wore crossed-corner headwraps, purple plum-blossom gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, gilded belts, and white brocade riding breeches; they carried bow and arrows, wore swords, held clubs, and stood in two files east and west beneath the eaves.

sentences.zh: 警蹕三人，以控鶴衛士為之。

translations.literal: Three clearing-the-way officers, drawn from the crane-controlling guards.
translations.idiomatic: Three route-clearing officers were drawn from the Crane-Controlling Guards.

sentences.zh: 冠交角襆頭，服紫羅窄袖衫，塗金束帶，烏靴，捧立於露階。

translations.literal: They wore crossed-corner headwraps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, gilded belts, and black boots, standing with batons at the open steps.
translations.idiomatic: They wore crossed-corner headwraps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, gilded belts, and black boots, and stood holding batons on the open terrace steps.

sentences.zh: 每乘輿出入，則鳴其鞭以警眾。

translations.literal: Whenever the emperor's carriage entered or left, they struck their whips to warn the crowd.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever the imperial carriage entered or left, they cracked their whips to warn the throng.

sentences.zh: 殿下執事

translations.literal: Attendants below the hall
translations.idiomatic: Attendants Below the Hall

sentences.zh: 司香二人，亦以主服御者攝之，冠服同殿上司香。

translations.literal: Two incense officers, also drawn from those who attend imperial garments; caps and dress the same as the upper-hall incense officers.
translations.idiomatic: Two incense officers, likewise drawn from the imperial wardrobe attendants, wore the same caps and dress as the upper-hall incense officers.

sentences.zh: 香案直露階南，司香東西相向立。

translations.literal: The incense table stood directly south of the open steps; the incense officers stood facing each other east and west.
translations.idiomatic: The incense table stood directly south of the open terrace; the incense officers faced each other across the east–west axis.

sentences.zh: 護尉，凡四十人，以戶郎

translations.literal: Guard-commanders, forty in all, drawn from household stewards
translations.idiomatic: Guard-commanders, forty in all, including household stewards

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰玉典赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called yudianchi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called yudianchi.)

sentences.zh: 二十人、質子二十人攝之，服同宇下護尉，夾立階。

translations.literal: twenty persons and twenty hostages filled the posts; dress the same as the eaves guard-commanders; they stood flanking the steps.
translations.idiomatic: twenty household stewards and twenty hostages filled the posts, wearing the same dress as the eaves guard-commanders and standing flanking the steps.

sentences.zh: 右階之下，伍長凡六人，都點檢一人，右點檢一人，左點檢一人。

translations.literal: Below the right steps: squad leaders six in all, one chief inspector, one right inspector, and one left inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Below the right steps were six squad leaders, one chief inspector, one right inspector, and one left inspector.

sentences.zh: 凡宿衛之人及諸門者、戶者，皆屬焉。

translations.literal: All those on night guard, at the various gates, and household stewards were subordinate to them.
translations.idiomatic: All night guards, gatekeepers, and household stewards were under their command.

sentences.zh: 〈（如怯薛歹、八剌哈赤、玉典赤之類是也。）〉

translations.literal: (Such as qiesixie, balaqachi, yudianchi, and the like.)
translations.idiomatic: (such as qiesixie, balaqachi, yudianchi, and the like.)

sentences.zh: 殿內將軍一人，凡殿內佩弓矢者、佩刀者、諸司禦者皆屬焉。

translations.literal: One inner-hall general; all within the hall who bore bow and arrows, who bore swords, and all palace-service officers were subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: One inner-hall general commanded all within the hall who carried bow and arrows or swords, and all palace-service officers.

sentences.zh: 〈（如火兒赤、溫都赤之類是也。）〉

translations.literal: (Such as qorichi and ündüchi, and the like.)
translations.idiomatic: (such as qorichi and ündüchi, and the like.)

sentences.zh: 殿外將軍一人，宇下護尉屬焉。

translations.literal: One outer-hall general; the eaves guard-commanders were subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: One outer-hall general commanded the eaves guard-commanders.

sentences.zh: 宿直將軍一人，黃麾立仗及殿下護尉屬焉。

translations.literal: One night-duty general; the yellow-banner standing guard and the below-hall guard-commanders were subordinate to him.
translations.idiomatic: One night-duty general commanded the yellow-banner standing guard and the below-hall guard-commanders.

sentences.zh: 右無常官，凡朝會，則以近侍重臣攝之。

translations.literal: At right there were no permanent officers; at every court assembly, nearby attendants and great ministers filled the posts.
translations.idiomatic: On the right there were no permanent officers; at every court assembly, intimate attendants and senior ministers filled the posts.

sentences.zh: 服白帽，白衲襖，行縢，履襪，或服其品之公服，恭事則侍立。

translations.literal: They wore white caps, white quilted jackets, gaiters, socks and shoes—or wore the public robes of their rank; when performing reverent duties they stood in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: They wore white caps, white quilted jackets, gaiters, and shoes with socks—or the court robes of their rank; during reverent ceremonies they stood in attendance.

sentences.zh: 舍人授以骨朵而易笏，都點檢以玉，右點檢以瑪瑙，左點檢以水精，殿內將軍以瑪瑙，殿外將軍以水精，宿直將軍以金。

translations.literal: Chamberlains gave them clubs in exchange for tablets; the chief inspector received jade, the right inspector agate, the left inspector crystal, the inner-hall general agate, the outer-hall general crystal, and the night-duty general gold.
translations.idiomatic: Chamberlains exchanged their tablets for clubs: the chief inspector received jade, the right inspector agate, the left inspector crystal, the inner-hall general agate, the outer-hall general crystal, and the night-duty general gold.

sentences.zh: 左階之下，伍長凡三人，殿內將軍一人，殿外將軍一人，宿直將軍一人，冠服同右，恭事則侍立。

translations.literal: Below the left steps: three squad leaders, one inner-hall general, one outer-hall general, and one night-duty general; caps and dress the same as at right; when performing reverent duties they stood in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Below the left steps were three squad leaders, one inner-hall general, one outer-hall general, and one night-duty general, with the same caps and dress as on the right; during reverent ceremonies they stood in attendance.

sentences.zh: 舍人授以骨朵而易笏，殿內將軍以瑪瑙，殿外將軍以水精，宿直將軍以金。

translations.literal: Chamberlains gave them clubs in exchange for tablets; the inner-hall general received agate, the outer-hall general crystal, and the night-duty general gold.
translations.idiomatic: Chamberlains exchanged their tablets for clubs: the inner-hall general received agate, the outer-hall general crystal, and the night-duty general gold.

sentences.zh: 司辰郎二人，一人立左樓上，服視六品，候時，北面而雞唱；

translations.literal: Two timekeepers: one stood on the left tower, dress equivalent to sixth rank, watched the time, faced north and crowed like a cock;
translations.idiomatic: Two timekeepers: one stood on the left tower in dress equivalent to sixth rank, watched the hour, faced north, and crowed like a cock;

sentences.zh: 一人立樓下，服視八品，候時，捧牙牌趨丹墀跪報。

translations.literal: one stood below the tower, dress equivalent to eighth rank, watched the time, bore the ivory tablet, hurried to the red steps, knelt and reported.
translations.idiomatic: one stood below the tower in dress equivalent to eighth rank, watched the hour, bore the ivory tally, hurried to the red steps, knelt, and reported.

sentences.zh: 露階之下，左黃麾仗內，設表案一，禮物案一，輿士凡八人，每案四人。

translations.literal: Below the open steps, within the left yellow-banner guard: one memorial table, one gift table, carriage attendants eight in all, four per table.
translations.idiomatic: Below the open terrace, within the left yellow-banner guard, stood one memorial table and one gift table, with eight carriage attendants—four at each table.

sentences.zh: 前二人冠縷金額交角襆頭，緋錦寶相花窄袖襖，塗金束帶，行縢，鞋襪。

translations.literal: The front two wore gold-threaded-brim crossed-corner headwraps, scarlet brocade treasure-flower narrow-sleeved jackets, gilded belts, gaiters, and shoes with socks.
translations.idiomatic: The front two wore gold-threaded crossed-corner headwraps, scarlet brocade narrow-sleeved jackets with treasure-flower patterns, gilded belts, gaiters, and shoes with socks.

sentences.zh: 後二人冠服同前，惟襖色青。

translations.literal: The rear two: caps and dress the same as the front, only the jacket color was blue.
translations.idiomatic: The rear two wore the same caps and dress as the front pair, but their jackets were blue.

sentences.zh: 圉人十人，

translations.literal: Stable hands, ten in all,
translations.idiomatic: Stable hands, ten in all,

sentences.zh: 〈（國語曰阿塔赤。）〉

translations.literal: (In the national language it is called atachi.)
translations.idiomatic: (In the national language it is called atachi.)

sentences.zh: 冠唐巾，紫羅窄袖衫，青錦緣白錦汗胯，銅束帶，烏靴，馭立仗馬十，覆以青錦緣緋錦鞍復，分左右，立黃麾仗南。

translations.literal: They wore Tang kerchiefs, purple gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, white brocade riding breeches bordered in blue brocade, copper belts, and black boots; they tended ten standing-guard horses covered with blue-bordered scarlet saddle cloths, divided left and right, standing south of the yellow-banner guard.
translations.idiomatic: They wore Tang kerchiefs, purple gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, white brocade riding breeches edged in blue brocade, copper belts, and black boots; they tended ten standing-guard horses draped in scarlet saddle cloths edged in blue brocade, split into left and right files south of the yellow-banner guard.

sentences.zh: 侍儀使二人，引進使一人，通班舍人一人，尚引舍人一人，閱仗舍人一人，奉引舍人一人，先輿舍人一人。

translations.literal: Two ceremonial commissioners, one introducing commissioner, one relay chamberlain, one leading-in chamberlain, one guard-inspection chamberlain, one guiding chamberlain, and one carriage-precedence chamberlain.
translations.idiomatic: Two ceremonial commissioners, one introducing commissioner, one relay chamberlain, one leading-in chamberlain, one guard-inspection chamberlain, one guiding chamberlain, and one carriage-precedence chamberlain.

sentences.zh: 糾儀官凡四人，尚書一人，侍郎一人，監察御史二人。

translations.literal: Ceremony-correcting officers four in all: one minister, one vice-minister, and two investigatory censors.
translations.idiomatic: Four ceremony-correcting officers: one minister, one vice-minister, and two investigatory censors.

sentences.zh: 知班三人，視班內失儀者，白糾儀官而行罰焉。

translations.literal: Three formation monitors watched for breaches of decorum within the formation and reported them to the ceremony-correcting officers for punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Three formation monitors watched for breaches of decorum in the ranks and reported offenders to the ceremony-correcting officers for punishment.

sentences.zh: 皆東向，立右仗之東，以北為上。

translations.literal: All faced east, standing east of the right guard, with north as the superior position.
translations.idiomatic: All faced east, standing east of the right guard, with the northernmost position highest in rank.

sentences.zh: 侍儀使二人，引進使一人，承奉班都知一人，宣表目舍人一人，宣表修撰一人，宣禮物舍人一人，奉表舍人一人，奉幣舍人一人，尚引舍人一人，閱仗舍人一人，奉引舍人一人，先輿舍人一人。

translations.literal: Two ceremonial commissioners, one introducing commissioner, one director of the presentation corps, one chamberlain who announced the memorial heading, one memorial-drafting reviser, one chamberlain who announced gifts, one memorial-presenting chamberlain, one tribute-presenting chamberlain, one leading-in chamberlain, one guard-inspection chamberlain, one guiding chamberlain, and one carriage-precedence chamberlain.
translations.idiomatic: Two ceremonial commissioners, one introducing commissioner, one director of the presentation corps, and chamberlains to announce the memorial heading, revise the memorial text, announce gifts, present the memorial, present the tribute, lead the procession in, inspect the guard, guide the ceremony, and take carriage precedence.

sentences.zh: 押禮物官凡二人，工部侍郎一人，禮部侍郎一人。

translations.literal: Gift-escorting officers two in all: one vice-minister of Works, one vice-minister of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: Two gift-escorting officers: one vice-minister of Works and one vice-minister of Rites.

sentences.zh: 糾儀官凡四人，尚書一人，侍郎一人，監察御史二人。

translations.literal: Ceremony-correcting officers four in all: one minister, one vice-minister, and two investigatory censors.
translations.idiomatic: Four ceremony-correcting officers: one minister, one vice-minister, and two investigatory censors.

sentences.zh: 知班三人，視班內如左右輦路。

translations.literal: Three formation monitors watched within the formation as on the left and right carriage paths.
translations.idiomatic: Three formation monitors watched the ranks as they did along the left and right carriage paths.

sentences.zh: 宣贊舍人一人，通贊舍人一人，戶郎二人，承傳贊席前，皆西向，立左仗之西，以北為上。

translations.literal: One announcing chamberlain, one relay-announcing chamberlain, two household stewards to relay announcements before the seats—all faced west, standing west of the left guard, with north as the superior position.
translations.idiomatic: One announcing chamberlain, one relay announcer, and two household stewards to relay announcements before the seats—all faced west, standing west of the left guard, with the northernmost position highest in rank.

sentences.zh: 凡侍儀使、引進使、尚書、侍郎、御史，各服其本品之服。

translations.literal: All ceremonial commissioners, introducing commissioners, ministers, vice-ministers, and censors each wore the robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: Ceremonial commissioners, introducing commissioners, ministers, vice-ministers, and censors each wore robes appropriate to their own rank.

sentences.zh: 承奉班都知、舍人，借四品服。

translations.literal: The director and chamberlains of the presentation corps borrowed fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: The director and chamberlains of the presentation corps wore borrowed fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 知班，冠展角襆頭，服紫羅窄袖衫，塗金束帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Formation monitors wore spread-corner headwraps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, gilded belts, and black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Formation monitors wore spread-corner headwraps, purple gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, gilded belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 護尉三十人，以質子在宿衛者攝之，立大明門闑外，冠服同宇下護尉。

translations.literal: Thirty guard-commanders, drawn from hostages on night guard, stood outside the gate leaves of the Great Bright Gate; caps and dress the same as the eaves guard-commanders.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty guard-commanders, drawn from hostages on night duty, stood outside the leaves of the Great Bright Gate, wearing the same caps and dress as the eaves guard-commanders.

sentences.zh: 承傳二人，控鶴衛士為之，立大明門楹間，以承傳於外仗。

translations.literal: Two relay officers, drawn from the crane-controlling guards, stood between the pillars of the Great Bright Gate to relay announcements to the outer guard.
translations.idiomatic: Two relay officers from the Crane-Controlling Guards stood between the pillars of the Great Bright Gate to relay announcements to the outer guard.

sentences.zh: 冠服同警蹕，執金柄小骨朵。

translations.literal: Caps and dress the same as the clearing-the-way officers; they held small clubs with gold handles.
translations.idiomatic: They wore the same caps and dress as the route-clearing officers and held small clubs with gold handles.

sentences.zh: 殿下黃麾仗

translations.literal: Yellow-banner guard below the hall
translations.idiomatic: Yellow-Banner Guard Below the Hall

sentences.zh: 〈（黃麾仗凡四百四十有八人，分布於丹墀左右，各五行。）〉

translations.literal: (The yellow-banner guard numbered four hundred forty-eight in all, distributed to left and right of the red steps, five ranks each.)
translations.idiomatic: (The yellow-banner guard numbered four hundred forty-eight in all, arrayed to the left and right of the red steps in five ranks each.)

sentences.zh: 右前列，執大蓋二人，執華蓋二人，執紫方蓋二人，執紅方蓋二人，執曲蓋二人，冠展角襆頭，服緋絁生色寶相花袍，勒帛，烏靴。

translations.literal: Right front rank: two bearing great canopies, two bearing flowered canopies, two bearing purple square canopies, two bearing red square canopies, two bearing curved canopies; they wore spread-corner headwraps, scarlet silk robes with treasure-flower patterns in living colors, waist bands, and black boots.
translations.idiomatic: In the right front rank were two bearers each of great canopies, flowered canopies, purple square canopies, red square canopies, and curved canopies; they wore spread-corner headwraps, scarlet silk robes patterned with treasure flowers in living colors, waist bands, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 次二列，執朱團扇八人，執大雉扇八人，執中雉扇八人，執小雉扇八人，執朱團扇八人，冠武弁，服同前執蓋者。

translations.literal: Second rank: eight bearing vermilion round fans, eight bearing great pheasant-tail fans, eight bearing medium pheasant-tail fans, eight bearing small pheasant-tail fans, eight bearing vermilion round fans; they wore military caps, dress the same as the canopy bearers before.
translations.idiomatic: The second rank comprised eight bearers each of vermilion round fans, great pheasant-tail fans, medium pheasant-tail fans, small pheasant-tail fans, and vermilion round fans; they wore military caps and the same dress as the canopy bearers in the front rank.

sentences.zh: 次三列，執黃麾幡十人，武弁，青絁生色寶相花袍，青勒帛，烏靴。

translations.literal: Third rank: ten bearing yellow-banner pennants; military caps; blue silk robes with treasure-flower patterns in living colors; blue waist bands; black boots.
translations.idiomatic: The third rank comprised ten bearers of yellow-banner pennants in military caps, blue silk robes patterned with treasure flowers in living colors, blue waist bands, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 執絳引幡十人，武弁，緋絁生色寶相花袍，緋勒帛，烏靴。

translations.literal: Ten bearing crimson guide pennants; military caps; scarlet silk robes with treasure-flower patterns in living colors; scarlet waist bands; black boots.
translations.idiomatic: Ten bore crimson guide pennants in military caps, scarlet silk robes patterned with treasure flowers in living colors, scarlet waist bands, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 執信幡十人，冠服同上，其色黃。

translations.literal: Ten bearing trust pennants; caps and dress the same as above, the color yellow.
translations.idiomatic: Ten bore trust pennants in the same caps and dress as above, in yellow.

sentences.zh: 執傳教幡十人，冠服同上，其色白。

translations.literal: Ten bearing transmission-of-command pennants; caps and dress the same as above, the color white.
translations.idiomatic: Ten bore transmission-of-command pennants in the same caps and dress as above, in white.

sentences.zh: 執告止幡十人，冠服同上，其色紫。

translations.literal: Ten bearing halt-announcement pennants; caps and dress the same as above, the color purple.
translations.idiomatic: Ten bore halt-announcement pennants in the same caps and dress as above, in purple.

sentences.zh: 次四列以下，執葆蓋四十人，武弁，服緋絁生色寶相花袍，勒帛，烏靴。

translations.literal: From the fourth rank downward: forty bearing parasol canopies; military caps; scarlet silk robes with treasure-flower patterns in living colors; waist bands; black boots.

translations.idiomatic: Next came two bamboo clappers, then four panpipes, four xiao pipes, two clappers, and four singers, all split left and right.

sentences.zh: 前行內琵琶二十，次箏十六，次箜篌十六，次緌十六，次方響八，次頭管二十八，次龍笛二十八，為三十三重。

translations.literal: Within the advance section: twenty pipa, next sixteen zithers, next sixteen konghou, next sixteen reeds, next eight fangxiang, next twenty-eight guanzi, next twenty-eight long flutes—in thirty-three ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Within the advance section were twenty pipa, then sixteen zithers, sixteen konghou, sixteen reeds, eight fangxiang, twenty-eight guanzi, and twenty-eight long flutes, arranged in thirty-three ranks.

translations.literal: (Four persons per rank.)
translations.idiomatic: (Four persons per rank.)

sentences.zh: 次杖鼓三十，為八重。

translations.literal: Next thirty barrel-drums, in eight ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came thirty barrel-drums in eight ranks.

sentences.zh: 次板八，為四重。

translations.literal: Next eight clappers, in four ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight clappers in four ranks.

sentences.zh: 板內大鼓二，工二人，舁八人。

translations.literal: Within the clappers, two great drums; two craftsmen, eight bearers.
translations.idiomatic: Within the clapper section were two great drums with two craftsmen and eight bearers.

sentences.zh: 本工服並與鹵簿同。

translations.literal: The craftsmen's dress was the same as in the regalia guard.
translations.idiomatic: The musicians' dress matched that of the regalia guard.

sentences.zh: 法物庫使二人，服本品服。

translations.literal: Two directors of the Ritual Objects Storehouse, wearing robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two directors of the Ritual Objects Storehouse wore robes of their own rank.

sentences.zh: 次朱團扇八，為二重。

translations.literal: Next eight vermilion round fans, in two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight vermilion round fans in two ranks.

sentences.zh: 次小雉扇八，次中雉扇八，次大雉扇八，分左右，為十二重。

translations.literal: Next eight small pheasant-tail fans, next eight medium pheasant-tail fans, next eight great pheasant-tail fans, divided left and right—in twelve ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight small, eight medium, and eight great pheasant-tail fans, split left and right in twelve ranks.

sentences.zh: 次朱團扇八，為二重。

translations.literal: Next eight vermilion round fans, in two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight vermilion round fans in two ranks.

sentences.zh: 次大傘二，次華蓋二，次紫方傘二，次紅方傘二，次曲蓋二，並分左右。

translations.literal: Next two great umbrellas, next two flowered canopies, next two purple square umbrellas, next two red square umbrellas, next two curved canopies—all divided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two great umbrellas, two flowered canopies, two purple square umbrellas, two red square umbrellas, and two curved canopies, all split left and right.

sentences.zh: 執傘扇所服，並同立仗。

translations.literal: The dress of those bearing umbrellas and fans was the same as the standing guard.
translations.idiomatic: Those bearing umbrellas and fans wore the same dress as the standing guard.

sentences.zh: 圍子頭一人，中道。

translations.literal: One enclosure-head officer, on the central path.
translations.idiomatic: One enclosure-head officer marched on the central path.

sentences.zh: 次圍子八人，分左右。

translations.literal: Next eight enclosure guards, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came eight enclosure guards to left and right.

sentences.zh: 服與鹵簿內同。

translations.literal: Dress the same as within the regalia guard.
translations.idiomatic: Their dress matched that within the regalia guard.

sentences.zh: 安和樂一部，署令二人，服本品服。

translations.literal: One Anhe Music ensemble; two directors, wearing robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Anhe Music ensemble with two directors in robes of their own rank.

sentences.zh: 劄鼓六，為二重，前四，後二。

translations.literal: Six zha drums, in two ranks—four in front, two behind.
translations.idiomatic: Six zha drums in two ranks: four in front and two behind.

sentences.zh: 次和鼓一，中道。

translations.literal: Next one harmony drum, on the central path.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one harmony drum on the central path.

sentences.zh: 次板二，分左右。

translations.literal: Next two clappers, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two clappers to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次龍笛四，次頭管四，並為二重。

translations.literal: Next four long flutes, next four guanzi—all in two ranks.
translations.idiomatic: Next came four long flutes and four guanzi in two ranks.

sentences.zh: 次羌管二，次笙二，並分左右。

translations.literal: Next two Qiang pipes, next two sheng—each divided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two Qiang pipes and two sheng, each split left and right.

sentences.zh: 次雲敖一，中道。

translations.literal: Next one yunao, on the central path.
translations.idiomatic: Next came one yunao on the central path.

sentences.zh: 次緌二，分左右。

translations.literal: Next two reeds, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two reeds to left and right.

sentences.zh: 樂工服與鹵簿內同。

translations.literal: Musicians' dress the same as within the regalia guard.
translations.idiomatic: The musicians wore the same dress as within the regalia guard.

sentences.zh: 傘一，中道，椅左，踏右，執人皂巾，大團花緋錦襖，金塗銅束帶，行縢，鞋襪。

translations.literal: One umbrella on the central path; chair to its left, footrest to its right; bearers wore black kerchiefs, large round-flower scarlet brocade jackets, gold-plated copper belts, gaiters, and shoes with socks.
translations.idiomatic: One umbrella on the central path with a chair to its left and a footrest to its right; bearers wore black kerchiefs, large round-flower scarlet brocade jackets, gold-plated copper belts, gaiters, and shoes with socks.

sentences.zh: 拱衛使一人，服本品服。

translations.literal: One Palace Guard commissioner, wearing robes of his own rank.
translations.idiomatic: One Palace Guard commissioner wore robes of his own rank.

sentences.zh: 舍人二人，次引寶官二人，並分左右，服四品服。

translations.literal: Two chamberlains, next two seal-guiding officers—all divided left and right, wearing fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Two chamberlains and next two seal-guiding officers, all split left and right in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 香案，中道，輿士控鶴八人，服同立仗內表案輿士。

translations.literal: Incense table on the central path; eight Crane-Controlling carriage attendants, dress the same as the memorial-table attendants of the standing guard.
translations.idiomatic: An incense table on the central path with eight Crane-Controlling carriage attendants in the same dress as the standing guard's memorial-table attendants.

sentences.zh: 侍香二人，分左右，服四品服。

translations.literal: Two incense attendants, left and right, wearing fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Two incense attendants to left and right in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 寶案，中道，輿士控鶴十有六人，服同香案輿士。

translations.literal: Treasure table on the central path; sixteen Crane-Controlling carriage attendants, dress the same as the incense-table attendants.
translations.idiomatic: A treasure table on the central path with sixteen Crane-Controlling carriage attendants in the same dress as the incense-table attendants.

sentences.zh: 方輿官三十人，夾香案寶案，分左右而趨，至殿門，則控鶴退，方輿官舁案以升。

translations.literal: Thirty square-carriage officers flanked the incense and treasure tables, hurrying left and right; at the hall gate the crane-controllers withdrew and the square-carriage officers lifted the tables to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty square-carriage officers flanked the incense and treasure tables and hurried to left and right; at the hall gate the crane-controllers withdrew and the square-carriage officers lifted the tables to ascend.

sentences.zh: 唐巾，紫羅窄袖衫，金塗銅束帶，烏靴。

translations.literal: Tang kerchiefs, purple gauze narrow-sleeved shirts, gold-plated copper belts, and black boots.
translations.idiomatic: They wore Tang kerchiefs, purple gauze narrow-sleeved tunics, gold-plated copper belts, and black boots.

sentences.zh: 引冊二人，四品服。

translations.literal: Two register-guiding officers, fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Two register-guiding officers in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 香案，中道，輿士控鶴八人，服同寶案輿士。

translations.literal: Incense table on the central path; eight Crane-Controlling carriage attendants, dress the same as the treasure-table attendants.
translations.idiomatic: An incense table on the central path with eight Crane-Controlling carriage attendants in the same dress as the treasure-table attendants.

sentences.zh: 侍香二人，分左右，服四品服。

translations.literal: Two incense attendants, left and right, wearing fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Two incense attendants to left and right in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 冊案，中道，輿士控鶴十有六人，服同寶案輿士。

translations.literal: Register table on the central path; sixteen Crane-Controlling carriage attendants, dress the same as the treasure-table attendants.
translations.idiomatic: A register table on the central path with sixteen Crane-Controlling carriage attendants in the same dress as the treasure-table attendants.

sentences.zh: 方輿官三十人，夾香案冊案，分左右而趨，至殿門，則控鶴退，方輿官舁案以升。

translations.literal: Thirty square-carriage officers flanked the incense and register tables, hurrying left and right; at the hall gate the crane-controllers withdrew and the square-carriage officers lifted the tables to ascend.
translations.idiomatic: Thirty square-carriage officers flanked the incense and register tables and hurried to left and right; at the hall gate the crane-controllers withdrew and the square-carriage officers lifted the tables to ascend.

sentences.zh: 巾服與寶案方輿官同。

translations.literal: Kerchiefs and dress the same as the treasure-table square-carriage officers.
translations.idiomatic: Their kerchiefs and dress matched those of the treasure-table square-carriage officers.

sentences.zh: 葆蓋四十人，次閱仗舍人二人，服四品服。

translations.literal: Forty parasol canopies, next two guard-inspection chamberlains, wearing fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Forty parasol canopies, then two guard-inspection chamberlains in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 次小戟四十人，次儀锽四十人，夾雲和樂傘扇，分左右行，服同立仗。

translations.literal: Next forty small halberds, next forty ceremonial gong-axes, flanking the Yunhe Music umbrellas and fans, marching left and right, dress the same as the standing guard.
translations.idiomatic: Next came forty small halberds and forty ceremonial gong-axes flanking the Yunhe Music umbrellas and fans, marching to left and right in the same dress as the standing guard.

sentences.zh: 拱衛使二人，服本品朝服。

translations.literal: Two Palace Guard commissioners, wearing court robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: Two Palace Guard commissioners wore court robes of their own rank.

sentences.zh: 次班劍十，次吾仗十二，次斧十二，次鐙仗二十，次列絲十，皆分左右。

translations.literal: Next ten court swords, next twelve ceremonial staffs, next twelve axes, next twenty stirrup-stands, next ten ceremonial silks—all divided left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came ten court swords, twelve ceremonial staffs, twelve axes, twenty stirrup-stands, and ten ceremonial silks, all split left and right.

sentences.zh: 次水瓶左，金盆右。

translations.literal: Next water bottle on the left, golden basin on the right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came a water bottle on the left and a golden basin on the right.

sentences.zh: 次列絲十，次立瓜十。

translations.literal: Next ten ceremonial silks, next ten standing melons.
translations.idiomatic: Next came ten ceremonial silks and ten standing melons.

sentences.zh: 次金杌左，鞭桶右；

translations.literal: Next golden folding stool on the left, whip bucket on the right;
translations.idiomatic: Next came a golden folding stool on the left and a whip bucket on the right;

sentences.zh: 蒙鞍左，傘手右。

translations.literal: saddle cover on the left, umbrella bearer on the right.
translations.idiomatic: a saddle cover on the left and an umbrella bearer on the right.

sentences.zh: 次立瓜十，次臥瓜三十。

translations.literal: Next ten standing melons, next thirty reclining melons.
translations.idiomatic: Next came ten standing melons and thirty reclining melons.

sentences.zh: 並夾葆蓋、小戟、儀锽，分左右行。

translations.literal: All flanked the parasol canopies, small halberds, and ceremonial gong-axes, marching left and right.
translations.idiomatic: All flanked the parasol canopies, small halberds, and ceremonial gong-axes and marched to left and right.

sentences.zh: 服並同鹵簿內。

translations.literal: Dress all the same as within the regalia guard.
translations.idiomatic: Their dress matched that within the regalia guard.

sentences.zh: 拱衛外舍人二人，服四品服，引導冊諸官。

translations.literal: Two outer Palace Guard chamberlains, fourth-rank robes, guiding the register officials.
translations.idiomatic: Two outer Palace Guard chamberlains in fourth-rank robes guided the register officials.

sentences.zh: 次從九品以上，次從七品以上，次從五品以上，並本品朝服。

translations.literal: Next those from ninth rank and above, next from seventh rank and above, next from fifth rank and above—all in court robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: Next followed officials from ninth rank upward, then seventh rank upward, then fifth rank upward, all in court robes of their respective ranks.

sentences.zh: 金吾折沖二人，牙門旗二，每旗引執五人。

translations.literal: Two Golden Guard repelling-the-enemy colonels, two gate banners—five guides and bearers for each banner.
translations.idiomatic: Two Golden Guard repelling-the-enemy colonels and two gate banners, each with five guides and bearers.

sentences.zh: 次青槊四十人，赤槊四十人，黃槊四十人，白槊四十人，紫槊四十人，並兜鍪甲靴，各隨槊之色，行導冊官外。

translations.literal: Next forty blue spears, forty red spears, forty yellow spears, forty white spears, and forty purple spears—all with helmets, armor, and boots matching the color of the spear, marching outside the register-guiding officials.
translations.idiomatic: Next came forty blue, forty red, forty yellow, forty white, and forty purple spears, each file in matching helmets, armor, and boots, marching outside the register-guiding officials.

sentences.zh: 冊案後，舍人二人，服四品服。

translations.literal: Behind the register table, two chamberlains, fourth-rank robes.
translations.idiomatic: Behind the register table were two chamberlains in fourth-rank robes.

sentences.zh: 次太尉右，司徒左。

translations.literal: Next Grand Marshal on the right, Minister of Education on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Next came the Grand Marshal on the right and the Minister of Education on the left.

sentences.zh: 次禮儀使二人，分左右。

translations.literal: Next two ceremonial commissioners, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came two ceremonial commissioners to left and right.

sentences.zh: 次舉冊官四人右，舉寶官四人左；

translations.literal: Next four register-lifting officers on the right, four treasure-lifting officers on the left;
translations.idiomatic: Next came four register-lifting officers on the right and four treasure-lifting officers on the left;

sentences.zh: 次讀冊官二人右，讀寶官二人左。

translations.literal: next two register-reading officers on the right, two treasure-reading officers on the left.
translations.idiomatic: next came two register-reading officers on the right and two treasure-reading officers on the left.

sentences.zh: 次閣門使四人，分左右。

translations.literal: Next four gate commissioners, left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Next came four gate commissioners to left and right.

sentences.zh: 並本品服。

translations.literal: All wearing robes of their own rank.
translations.idiomatic: All wore robes of their own rank.

sentences.zh: 知班六人，分左右，服同立仗，往來視諸官之失儀者而行罰焉。

translations.literal: Six formation monitors, left and right, dress the same as the standing guard, moving back and forth to watch officials for breaches of decorum and impose punishment.
translations.idiomatic: Six formation monitors to left and right, dressed like the standing guard, moved among the officials to spot breaches of decorum and impose punishment.

translations.literal: Acting commissioners for registers and seals
translations.idiomatic: Acting Commissioners for Registers and Seals

sentences.zh: 上皇太后冊寶，凡攝官二百五十人，攝太尉一人，攝司徒一人，禮儀使四人，奉冊官二人，奉寶官二人，引冊官二人，引寶官二人，舉冊官二人，舉寶官二人，讀冊官二人，讀寶官二人，捧冊官二人，捧寶官二人，奏中嚴一人，主當內侍十人，閣門使六人，充內臣十三人，糾儀官四人，代禮官四十二人，掌謁四人，司香十二人，折沖都尉二人，拱衛使二人，清道官四人，警蹕官四人，方輿官百二十人。

sentences.zh: 太皇太后冊寶，攝官同前。

translations.literal: For the grand empress dowager's registers and seals, the acting commissioners were the same as before.
translations.idiomatic: For the grand empress dowager's registers and seals, the acting commissioners were the same as above.

sentences.zh: 授皇后冊寶，凡攝官百八十人，攝太尉一人，攝司徒一人，主節官二人，禮儀使四人，奉冊官二人，奉寶官二人，引冊官二人，引寶官二人，舉冊官二人，舉寶官二人，讀冊官二人，讀寶官二人，內臣職掌十人，宣徽使二人，閤門使四人，代禮官三十七人，侍香二人，清道官四人，折沖都尉二人，警蹕官四人，中宮內臣九人，糾儀官四人，接冊內臣二人，接寶內臣二人，方輿官七十四人。

translations.literal: For investing the empress with registers and seals, acting commissioners numbered one hundred eighty: one acting Grand Marshal, one acting Minister of Education, two chief staff officers, four ceremonial commissioners, two register-presenting officers, two treasure-presenting officers, two register-guiding officers, two treasure-guiding officers, two register-lifting officers, two treasure-lifting officers, two register-reading officers, two treasure-reading officers, ten inner attendants in charge of duties, two Directorate commissioners, four gate commissioners, thirty-seven ritual substitutes, two incense attendants, four path-clearing officers, tworepelling-the-enemy colonels, four clearing-the-way officers, nine central-palace inner attendants, four ceremony-correcting officers, two inner attendants receiving the register, two inner attendants receiving the treasure, and seventy-four square-carriage officers.

sentences.zh: 授皇太子冊，凡攝官四十有九人，攝太尉一人，奉冊官二人，持節官一人，捧冊官二人，讀冊官二人，引冊官二人，攝禮儀使二人，主當內侍六人，副持節官五人，侍從官十一人，代禮官十六人。

translations.literal: For investing the heir apparent with the register, acting commissioners numbered forty-nine: one acting Grand Marshal, two register-presenting officers, one staff-bearing officer, two register-bearers, two register-reading officers, two register-guiding officers, two acting ceremonial commissioners, six chief inner attendants, five associate staff-bearing officers, eleven attendant officers, and sixteen ritual substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: For investing the heir apparent with the register, acting commissioners numbered forty-nine: one acting Grand Marshal, two register-presenters, one staff-bearer, two register-bearers, two register-readers, two register-guides, two acting ceremonial commissioners, six chief inner attendants, five associate staff-bearers, eleven attendants, and sixteen ritual substitutes.

sentences.zh: 班序先期，侍儀使糾庀陳設。

translations.literal: The formation order was arranged in advance; ceremonial commissioners inspected and set out the furnishings.
translations.idiomatic: The formation order was arranged in advance, and ceremonial commissioners inspected and set out the furnishings.

sentences.zh: 殿內兩楹北，香案二。

translations.literal: Within the hall, north of the two inner pillars, two incense tables.
translations.idiomatic: Within the hall, north of the two inner pillars, stood two incense tables.

sentences.zh: 殿門內，殿內將軍板位二。

translations.literal: Inside the hall gate, two inner-hall general mat positions.
translations.idiomatic: Inside the hall gate were two inner-hall general mat positions.

sentences.zh: 其外，殿外將軍板位二。

translations.literal: Outside them, two outer-hall general mat positions.
translations.idiomatic: Outside them were two outer-hall general mat positions.

sentences.zh: 宇下，斜界護尉板位二。

translations.literal: Beneath the eaves, two guard-commander mat positions set diagonally.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the eaves were two guard-commander mat positions set diagonally.

sentences.zh: 軒溜前斜外出畫白蓮六，右點檢板位三，左宣徽板位三。

translations.literal: Before the eaves, six white lotuses painted diagonally outward; three right-inspector mat positions on the right, three Directorate mat positions on the left.
translations.idiomatic: Before the eaves, six white lotuses were painted diagonally outward; on the right were three right-inspector mat positions and on the left three Directorate mat positions.

sentences.zh: 蓮南一步，橫列鳴鞭板位三。

translations.literal: One step south of the lotuses, three whip-strike mat positions set horizontally.
translations.idiomatic: One step south of the lotuses, three whip-strike mat positions were set horizontally.

sentences.zh: 左右階南兩隅，天武板位二。

translations.literal: At the southern corners of the left and right steps, two Heavenly Martial mat positions.
translations.idiomatic: At the southern corners of the left and right steps were two Heavenly Martial mat positions.

sentences.zh: 宇下左右第一第三重，敘界導從板位二。

translations.literal: Beneath the eaves, at the first and third ranks left and right, two guide-and-escort mat positions marking the boundary.
translations.idiomatic: Beneath the eaves, at the first and third ranks to left and right, were two guide-and-escort mat positions marking the boundary.

sentences.zh: 殿東門兩磌斜界出導從二道三層，各圈十五，先扇锜各五，寶蓋锜各二。

translations.literal: At the hall's east gate, two diagonal lines from the pillar bases marked two guide-and-escort paths in three ranks, fifteen circles each; first five fan enclosures each, two treasure-canopy enclosures each.
translations.idiomatic: At the hall's east gate, two diagonal lines from the pillar bases marked guide-and-escort paths in three ranks of fifteen circles each, with five fan enclosures and two treasure-canopy enclosures at the front of each.

sentences.zh: 殿東階下各圈十，直至東門階下，為回倒導從位。

translations.literal: Below the hall's east steps, ten circles each, continuing to below the east gate steps—these were the returning guide-and-escort positions.
translations.idiomatic: Below the hall's east steps were ten circles each, continuing to below the east gate steps as the returning guide-and-escort positions.

sentences.zh: 正階下二十四甓，香案一。

translations.literal: Below the main steps, twenty-four paving bricks; one incense table.
translations.idiomatic: Below the main steps, across twenty-four paving bricks, stood one incense table.

sentences.zh: 護尉席內各迤內第四螭首取直，邊北，左右護尉第五席相向布席，北二席宿直。

translations.literal: Within the guard-commander mats, taking a straight line from the fourth dragon-head tile inward along each side path to the north edge; the fifth guard-commander mats left and right faced each other; the northern two mats were for night duty.
translations.idiomatic: Within the guard-commander mats, a straight line was taken from the fourth dragon-head tile inward along each side path to the northern edge; the fifth guard-commander mats to left and right faced each other, with the northern two reserved for night duty.

sentences.zh: 次殿中，次典瑞，次起居，每席函丈五尺。

translations.literal: Next the hall center, next the ritual tally, next the attendance record—each mat measured one zhang five chi.
translations.idiomatic: Next came mats for the hall center, ritual tally, and attendance record, each measuring one zhang five chi.

sentences.zh: 設殿前板位八，各以左右道內邊丹墀迤內第五甓縱直，北空路五丈五尺，東西走路各違四丈九尺，中布席四十，席函九尺，設護尉板位二。

translations.literal: Eight mat positions were set before the hall; each followed the fifth paving brick straight north along the inner edge of the red steps on the left and right paths; open space to the north five zhang five chi; east and west walkways each five zhang nine chi wide; forty mats laid in the center, each mat nine chi square; two guard-commander mat positions were set.
translations.idiomatic: Eight mat positions were laid before the hall, each aligned north along the fifth paving brick on the inner edge of the red steps to left and right, with five zhang five chi of open space to the north, east and west walkways five zhang nine chi wide, forty nine-chi mats in the center, and two guard-commander mat positions.

sentences.zh: 輦路東西各五道，袤二丈一仞五寸。

translations.literal: East and west of the carriage path, five lanes each, length two zhang one ren five cun.
translations.idiomatic: To east and west of the carriage path were five lanes each, two zhang one ren five cun in length.

sentences.zh: 南北兩道，廣丈有奇。

translations.literal: The two north-south lanes were somewhat more than one zhang wide.
translations.idiomatic: The two north-south lanes were somewhat more than one zhang wide.

sentences.zh: 北至道當中，第一北三南一，自兩端各函六丈。

translations.literal: In the northern central lane, the first rank: three mats north and one south, six zhang square from each end.
translations.idiomatic: In the northern central lane, the first rank had three mats to the north and one to the south, six zhang square measured from each end.

sentences.zh: 第二北起十一，各函丈咫，南起九，各函丈三尺。

translations.literal: The second rank: starting at eleven in the north, each mat one zhang one chi square; starting at nine in the south, each mat one zhang three chi square.
translations.idiomatic: The second rank began at eleven in the north with mats one zhang one chi square each, and at nine in the south with mats one zhang three chi square each.

sentences.zh: 第三北起十三，各函丈五尺，南起十二，各函丈五寸。

translations.literal: The third rank: starting at thirteen in the north, each mat one zhang five chi square; starting at twelve in the south, each mat one zhang five cun square.
translations.idiomatic: The third rank began at thirteen in the north with mats one zhang five chi square each, and at twelve in the south with mats one zhang five cun square each.

sentences.zh: 第四北起十六，各函丈二尺，南起十四，各函九尺。

translations.literal: The fourth rank: starting at sixteen in the north, each mat one zhang two chi square; starting at fourteen in the south, each mat nine chi square.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth rank began at sixteen in the north with mats one zhang two chi square each, and at fourteen in the south with mats nine chi square each.

sentences.zh: 第五北起，同上南起，各函八尺，北頭曲尺路內，各函九尺，設黃麾仗锜二百二十。

translations.literal: The fifth rank: as above in the north; as above in the south, each mat eight chi square; within the L-shaped path at the northern end, each mat nine chi square; two hundred twenty yellow-banner guard enclosures were set.
translations.idiomatic: The fifth rank matched the pattern above in north and south with eight-chi mats; within the L-shaped path at the northern end were nine-chi mats, and two hundred twenty yellow-banner guard enclosures were set.

sentences.zh: 仗南畫闌約丈許，左右同，中央置席，設尚廄板位二。

translations.literal: South of the guard, a railing about one zhang was painted, the same left and right; mats were placed in the center; two Imperial Stables mat positions were set.
translations.idiomatic: South of the guard a railing about one zhang high was painted on both sides; mats were placed in the center and two Imperial Stables mat positions were set.

sentences.zh: 仗內丹墀橫界一十八道，道函五尺，縱引橫引三丈，中設九品板位一十八。

translations.literal: Within the guard, the red steps were divided by eighteen horizontal lines; each lane five chi wide; longitudinal and transverse guides three zhang; in the center eighteen ninth-rank mat positions were set.
translations.idiomatic: Within the guard the red steps were divided by eighteen horizontal lanes five chi wide, with longitudinal and transverse guides of three zhang, and eighteen ninth-rank mat positions in the center.

sentences.zh: 尚廄南左右縱畫各一十八道，道函仞，左右向，設起居旁折板位三十六，以內為上。

translations.literal: South of the Imperial Stables, eighteen longitudinal lines were painted left and right; each lane one ren wide, facing inward; thirty-six attendance side-fold mat positions were set, with the inner positions superior.
translations.idiomatic: South of the Imperial Stables, eighteen longitudinal lanes one ren wide were painted to left and right facing inward, with thirty-six attendance side-fold mat positions, the inner ones holding higher rank.

sentences.zh: 大明門中兩楹外，斜界二道，護尉板位二，外設管旗板位二。

translations.literal: Outside the two inner pillars of the Great Bright Gate, two diagonal paths; two guard-commander mat positions; outside them two banner-supervisor mat positions.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the two inner pillars of the Great Bright Gate were two diagonal paths, two guard-commander mat positions, and outside them two banner-supervisor mat positions.

sentences.zh: 門下左右闕邊各六丈，南北各畫一道，廣一引七丈一仞六寸，空各二丈一仞，內橫二引二丈五寸，空各三丈五尺。

translations.literal: Below the gate, six zhang from each side of the towers left and right; one lane painted north and south each; width one guide seven zhang one ren six cun; open space two zhang one ren each; within, two transverse guides two zhang five cun; open space three zhang five chi each.
translations.idiomatic: Below the gate, six zhang from each tower wing to left and right, one lane was painted on each north-south side, one guide seven zhang one ren six cun wide, with open spaces of two zhang one ren, and within them two transverse guides of two zhang five cun with open spaces of three zhang five chi.

sentences.zh: 每锜後丈五尺屏風渠一道，長五尺，坐各違四壁丈五尺，設牙旗锜七十四。

translations.literal: Behind each enclosure, one screen-channel five chi long; seats each five chi from the four walls; seventy-four gate-banner enclosures were set.
translations.idiomatic: Behind each enclosure was a five-chi screen-channel; seats stood five chi from each wall; seventy-four gate-banner enclosures were set.

sentences.zh: 闕下兩觀內各六丈，縱各界一十八道，道違仞，左右設外序班板位三十六。

translations.literal: Within each watchtower below the gate, six zhang each; eighteen longitudinal boundary lines each; lanes one ren wide; thirty-six outer formation mat positions left and right.
translations.idiomatic: Within each watchtower below the gate, six zhang across, were eighteen longitudinal boundary lines one ren wide, with thirty-six outer-formation mat positions to left and right.

sentences.zh: 自序班北入闕左右門邊兩外仗往北折，西至月華門，東至日精門，道中央入至起居旁折界一道導引。

translations.literal: From north of the formation, entering the gate's left and right side doors, the two outer guards turned north and west to the Moon Splendor Gate and east to the Sun Essence Gate; one central path entered to the attendance side-fold boundary line as guide.
translations.idiomatic: From north of the formation, entering through the gate's left and right side doors, the two outer guards turned north—west to the Moon Splendor Gate and east to the Sun Essence Gate—with one central path leading in to the attendance side-fold boundary as the guide.
